image_description: A high-angle, wide shot of a church interior featuring a central stone altar. The altar is a rectangular block structure with gold detailing and religious iconography on the front panel. It is flanked by large floral arrangements in vases. Above the altar is a stone archway leading to an apse with a circular window (oculus) emitting bright light. In the foreground, wooden pews are visible. To the left, a modern lectern stands near the altar. The walls are made of rough-hewn stone blocks.
